//==
// # IVector styling
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Paint and fill styling
//  - Stroke styling

//==
// # Paint and fill styling
//
// What a region is filled with: gradients, texture paints, the paint sum that
// selects among them, the fill description, drop shadows, and the styled-path
// pairing of geometry with appearance. Consumes Path2D from `paths.types.plato`,
// Color/ColorGradient from `color.types.plato`, and Texture2D from `texturing.types.plato`;
// the stroke side follows in the next section.

// How a gradient continues beyond its defining geometry: clamp to the end
// colors (Pad), mirror-repeat (Reflect), or tile (Repeat).
type GradientSpread = Pad | Reflect | Repeat;
